commit.message:
feat: motion library v1 + anatomy v3 + Glass Wing intake (#9)

* feat: motion library v1 + anatomy v3 + Glass Wing intake

Ships the SZL agent body as verifiable artifacts:

motion/ — three zero-dependency SVG+CSS animations
  • heart-beat.svg  — YUYAY heart pulse + sha256 receipt drop (1.2s loop)
  • receipt-rain.svg — YAWAR bus receipt stream (3.2s loop)
  • tripwire-ring.svg — HUKLLA observer ring sweep (6.0s loop)
  • exports/{stills, 6s mp4, 6s gif} for embed
  • prefers-reduced-motion fallback baked in, no JS, CC-BY-4.0

anatomy/ — full-body v3 PDF + 300dpi PNG
  • organic body silhouette, brain shaped like a brain
  • 6 canonical kernel vertebrae down the spine
  • all 5 doctrine principles + license badges as floating annotations
  • zero rectangles, 3-pass visual review

posts/ — linkedin / substack / medium drafts
  • TL;DR pitch: every heartbeat produces a sha256 receipt you can verify
  • pre-Series-A status and open hygiene disclosed honestly

docs/ — architecture
  • maki_chaki_limbs_proposal.md §13 synthesis added
  • architecture_synthesis_tldr.md (1-page exec view)
  • glass_wing_pod.md — public-surface intake & inversion playbook
  • anthropic_khipu_pod.md — khipu extraction, 111 citations

CITATION.cff — Jr. suffix removed, date-released bumped

Doctrine sweep:
  • Jr.: 0 occurrences in push-bound files
  • AlloyScape mentions: 4, all in honest open-problem disclosures
  • Author: Lutar, Stephen P. throughout
  • License: CC-BY-4.0 (docs) / Apache-2.0 (code)
  • All deps public + MIT/Apache/BSD/CC-BY

Author: Lutar, Stephen P.
ORCID: 0009-0001-0110-4173
SZL Holdings

* rename: Glass Wing → RIKCH'AY, Khipu → WILLAKUY (SZL-native Quechua)

Codenames now SZL-native:
- RIKCH'AY (Quechua: to awaken / to perceive clearly) — public-surface intake & inversion playbook
- WILLAKUY (Quechua: to recount, to bear witness, the telling) — Anthropic public-surface witness

Why:
- Glass Wing collided with Anthropic's Project Pillpintu design system. SZL refuses to borrow language from the labs being inverted.
- Khipu is too generic. Willakuy carries Quechua's testimonial weight and binds these docs to the same root family as the rest of the kernel set (yuyay, yawar, hatun, hukla, maki, chaki, musquy, rimay, tukuy).

Files renamed in repo:
  docs/glass_wing_pod.md      → docs/rikchay_pod.md
  docs/anthropic_khipu_pod.md → docs/anthropic_willakuy_pod.md

All cross-references updated. All file contents updated. Verified clean.

Author: Lutar, Stephen P. · ORCID 0009-0001-0110-4173 · SZL Holdings

* feat(anatomy): add anatomy/brain.pdf diagram

* feat(anatomy): add anatomy/wires.pdf diagram

* feat(anatomy): add anatomy/hatun_body_graph.pdf diagram

* feat(anatomy): add anatomy/agent_architecture.pdf diagram

* fix: split given-names + name-particle per CFF schema (doctrine BLOCK-03)

commit.message:
feat(previews): regenerate 14 banners with post-audit verified stats

Drops three hallucinated stats from the 2026-05-04 generator:
 - 'ouroboros-thesis: 13 Papers / v10 Latest' -> '11 Papers / v11 Latest'
 - 'a11oy: 8 Verticals' (fabricated ROSIE 8th surface) -> '7 Surfaces'
 - 'sentra: 6 Proof Steps' + typography glitches on overflow values

Adds three new banners to cover the full public footprint:
 - org-profile.png (also committed as .github.png) for szl-holdings/.github
 - stephenlutar2-hash.png for founder GitHub profile
 - szl-brand.png for this repo (was missing)

Also adds an auto-shrink routine for long stat values (e.g. '<=0.59ms'
which previously overflowed the stat-card frame) and a longer title
fallback sequence (50-82 px). Generator now prints a total at the
end. Deterministic: same inputs -> byte-identical PNGs.

README rewritten with:
 - full 14-banner catalog + per-banner 'why this asset' column
 - a 'Data sources for every stat' table citing where each
   number on each banner comes from in the platform repo
 - honest upload-is-manual guidance (GitHub REST API does not
   expose the /social-preview endpoint through the PAT proxy)

All stats re-verified against SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md, THESIS_PUBLICATIONS.md
(post-PR-144 and PR-145 sweeps), the monorepo packages/ dir, the
szl-trust reference run, and live Zenodo DOI resolution.

chore(license): use canonical CC-BY-4.0 text so GitHub detects SPDX ID

Also adds a NOTICE file preserving the trademark reservation that
was previously folded into the LICENSE file. Canonical CC-BY-4.0
text is required for GitHub's license detector to tag the repo.
